lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: an old-school car flipper starts a live stream to show off, but loses the deal to a viewer with a bot; the fail goes viral. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Lines: 1 loud, cheesy blogger greeting; 2 boastful; 3 excited, then running, out of breath; 4 shocked; 5 embarrassed excuse; 6 tired, resigned.

stas.profile: Stas — a calm, confident young Russian used-car flipper in his 30s, a bit cheeky.
stas.notes: One line: cheerful, teasing, waving to the camera.

luda.profile: Luda — a friendly, talkative Russian woman in her 40s who just sold her car.
luda.notes: One line: surprised but cheerful, a bit apologetic.
